entities.summary: Tapan Kumar Pradhan (b. 1972-10-22, Bhubaneswar) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bhubaneswar and India. Known in the fields of india, poets & playwrights, asia.
